event_envelope.event_id: stable opaque ID; preserve on retry
event_envelope.name: allowed canonical event name
event_envelope.project_id: resolved by collector configuration, not trusted from client
event_envelope.subject_id: project-scoped pseudonymous person/account or permitted anonymous identity
event_envelope.surface: landing, web, mobile, telegram, desktop or api
event_envelope.properties: validated per-event allowlist; never arbitrary payloads

events.name: page_viewed
events.when: included landing or allowlisted public route actually viewed

events.name: product_entered
events.when: usable product entry; first occurrence starts the entry cohort

events.name: registered
events.when: identity or account creation committed; optional when no registration

events.name: first_value
events.when: brief-defined useful result completed successfully for the first time
events.trust: authoritative product operation; native-local trust disclosed

events.name: value_repeated
events.when: a subsequent distinct useful product result completed

events.name: checkout_started
events.when: checkout session created; optional for monetized products
events.trust: server preferred; client diagnostic never payment proof

events.name: payment_succeeded
events.when: verified successful charge recorded once in provider ledger

events.name: payment_refunded
events.when: verified partial or full refund recorded once against original charge

event_registry_policy: Listed events are the canonical core. Extend with typed, allowlisted events only for selected module needs; never accept arbitrary client goals as privileged facts.
